SELECT
    RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID,
    m.CIF,
    m.NATIONAL_ID,
    m.BANK_ACCOUNT,
    m.OWNER_NAME_AR,
    m.COMPANY_NAME,
    m.COMPANY_NAME_AR,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
    m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,
    m.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
    m.ADDRESS_EN,
    m.ADDRESS_AR,
    m.CITY,
    m.REGION,
    m.BRANCH_CODE,
    m.BRANCH_NAME,
    m.MOBILE_PRIMARY,
    m.MCC,
    m.CATEGORY_EN,
    m.CATEGORY_AR,
    m.CONTRACT_MDR,
    m.STANDARD_MDR,
    m.MDR_APPROVAL_STATUS,
    m.MDR_SWITCH,
    m.QR_MDR,
    m.EXPECTED_MONTHLY_TPV,
    m.PACKAGE_ID,
    m.MCC_ID,
    m.TITLE_ID
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
WHERE m.MERCHANT_ID =
    HEXTORAW(
        REPLACE(
            '{{ JS_Merchant_Workplace.getMerchantId() }}',
            '-',
            ''
        )
    )
AND NVL(m.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
